```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a pairplot
pairplot = sns.pairplot(iris, hue="species", palette="Set1", diag_kind="kde", markers=["o", "s", "D"])

# Add a title
pairplot.fig.suptitle("Iris Dataset Pairplot by Species", y=1.02)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
